name: Darkwood Forest
desc1: This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
desc2: The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
desc3: branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
desc4: pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
desc5: and are nearly as thick as leather. The road passing through this
desc6: forest is barely lit as the canopy of branches overhead nearly blocks
desc7: out the light from the sun.
